about.text: Snezhok is a sweetened, sour-cream-like Soviet-era drink, mass-produced across the CIS and developed in the 1960s as a substitute for Bulgarian yoghurt. Pasteurised milk is soured with Lactobacillus bulgaricus and lactic streptococcus, and usually sweetened with sugar or fruit or berry syrup.
